display.purpose: Heavy card titles, proof totals, and section emphasis.

body.purpose: Compact explanatory copy and table notes.

data.purpose: Measured values, navigation counts, labels, and status records.

clock.purpose: The live cache expiry decision only.

shadows.name: card-stack
shadows.purpose: Registered paper-and-ink layers plus restrained ambient lift for the foreground card.

shadows.name: painted-control
shadows.purpose: Mechanical offset for actionable buttons; removed while pressed.

shadows.name: menu-strip
shadows.purpose: Quiet separation between the utility strip and stippled desktop.

motion.name: card-step-in
motion.purpose: Single 3px translate-and-fade transition when the addressable foreground card changes; disabled for reduced motion.

components.name: Painted Button
components.description: Mechanical previous, next, and retry action with a square border and offset press state.
components.css: .ds-painted-button { min-height: 34px; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #111111); border-radius: 0; color: var(--ink, #111111); background: var(--paper, #fbfbf7); box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 var(--ink, #111111); cursor: pointer; font: 700 11px "Courier New", Courier, monospace; } .ds-painted-button:hover, .ds-painted-button:active { color: var(--paper, #fbfbf7); background: var(--ink, #111111); } .ds-painted-button:active { transform: translate(2px, 2px); box-shadow: none; } .ds-painted-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px double var(--ink, #111111); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-painted-button:disabled { color: var(--gray, #757570); border-color: var(--gray, #757570); box-shadow: none; cursor: default; }

components.name: Stack Navigation
components.description: Direct navigation among the three addressable cards.
components.html: <nav class="ds-stack-nav" aria-label="Stack cards"><button type="button" aria-current="page">Live</button><button type="button">Composition</button><button type="button">Turns</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-stack-nav { display: flex; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #111111); background: var(--paper, #fbfbf7); } .ds-stack-nav button { border: 0; border-left: 1px solid var(--ink, #111111); border-radius: 0; padding: 7px 12px; color: var(--ink, #111111); background: var(--paper, #fbfbf7); cursor: pointer; font: 700 13px Geneva, "MS Sans Serif", Tahoma, sans-serif; } .ds-stack-nav button:first-child { border-left: 0; } .ds-stack-nav button[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--paper, #fbfbf7); background: var(--ink, #111111); } .ds-stack-nav button:hover:not([aria-current="page"]) { background-image: radial-gradient(var(--ink, #111111) .6px, transparent .7px); background-size: 3px 3px; } .ds-stack-nav button:focus-visible { outline: 3px double var(--ink, #111111); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Shoebox Card
components.description: Foreground stock with a striped title bar and registered offset layers.
components.html:
Live Cache

Card 1 of 3
Decision and proof
components.css: .ds-card { overflow: hidden; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #111111); border-radius: 0; color: var(--ink, #111111); background: var(--paper, #fbfbf7); box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 var(--paper, #fbfbf7), 7px 7px 0 var(--ink, #111111), 12px 14px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, .2); font-family: Geneva, "MS Sans Serif", Tahoma, sans-serif; } .ds-card-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 54px; padding: 7px 10px 7px 14px; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ink, #111111); background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, var(--paper, #fbfbf7) 0 2px, var(--ink, #111111) 2px 3px); } .ds-card-bar h2 { margin: 0; padding: 3px 10px 4px; background: var(--paper, #fbfbf7); font: 900 24px/1 Chicago, Charcoal, Fixedsys, "MS Sans Serif", Tahoma, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.035em; } .ds-card-bar span { margin-left: auto; padding: 3px 6px; background: var(--paper, #fbfbf7); font: 700 11px "Courier New", Courier, monospace; } .ds-card-content { padding: 22px; }

components.name: Decision Band
components.description: Explicit cache state and supporting record in a decisive black action band.
components.html: CACHE LIVEPREFIX READY
components.css: .ds-state-band { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; min-height: 36px; padding: 7px 10px; color: var(--paper, #fbfbf7); background: var(--ink, #111111); font: 900 13px Chicago, Charcoal, Fixedsys, "MS Sans Serif", Tahoma, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .02em; } .ds-state-detail { font: 700 11px "Courier New", Courier, monospace; letter-spacing: 0; } .ds-state-band[data-state="pending"], .ds-state-band[data-state="expired"] { color: var(--ink, #111111); background-color: var(--paper, #fbfbf7); background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, var(--ink, #111111) 0 1px, transparent 1px 5px); border: 2px solid var(--ink, #111111); } .ds-state-band[data-state="pending"] > *, .ds-state-band[data-state="expired"] > * { padding: 1px 5px; background: var(--paper, #fbfbf7); }

components.name: Result Stamp
components.description: Text-first SAVED, INVESTED, or REBUILT record with hard or double rules.
components.css: .ds-result-stamp { display: inline-block; padding: 4px 7px; border: 3px double var(--ink, #111111); color: var(--ink, #111111); background: var(--paper, #fbfbf7); font: 700 11px "Courier New", Courier, monospace; transform: rotate(-1deg); }

components.name: Composition Strip
components.description: One-bit token composition using solid and dithered segments.
components.css: .ds-composition-strip { display: flex; height: 72px; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #111111); overflow: hidden; } .ds-composition-strip span { min-width: 2px; border-right: 1px solid var(--ink, #111111); } .ds-composition-strip span:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-solid { background: var(--ink, #111111); } .ds-dither-heavy { background-color: var(--gray, #757570); background-image: radial-gradient(var(--paper, #fbfbf7) .55px, transparent .7px); background-size: 3px 3px; } .ds-dither-light { background-color: var(--paper, #fbfbf7); background-image: radial-gradient(var(--ink, #111111) .6px, transparent .7px); background-size: 4px 4px; }

narrative.overview:
Cache Stats is a one-bit utility stack: black ink on white card stock, stipple grays, hard rules, painted controls, and offset layers. It borrows the directness of classic HyperCard without turning the product into nostalgia or a conventional rounded analytics dashboard.

The system stages dense operational evidence as a three-card stack. Decisive text and patterned materials carry status, while data typography and hard geometry keep live decisions, cost proof, and forensic records legible.
keyCharacteristics: One-bit black-and-white hierarchy with stipple gray materials
Square, hard-bordered controls and offset card layers
Chicago-like display labels, Geneva-like body text, and Courier data
Text-and-pattern status treatment with a single stepped card transition

rules.name: The One-Bit Rule
rules.body: Meaning comes from black/white inversion, labels, borders, and pattern; do not introduce semantic color.

rules.name: The Pattern Means State Rule
rules.body: Status distinction must pair explicit text with solid, stippled, striped, or double-rule treatment so it never depends on tone alone.

rules.name: The Three-Face Rule
rules.body: Use display type for decisions, body type for explanation, and monospaced type for measured or addressable information.

rules.name: The Stack-Presence Rule
rules.body: Even while one card owns focus, the remaining cards stay spatially present as offset layers.

rules.name: The Offset, Then Air Rule
rules.body: Establish depth with registered hard offsets first; ambient blur is secondary and reserved for the outer shell.

rules.name: The Hard Edge Rule
rules.body: Keep controls, cards, and data regions square; distinguish them with 1px dividers, 2px structural borders, and occasional 3px double outlines.

rules.name: The Decision-First Rule
rules.body: On operational cards, lead with the live expiry decision and cost-at-expiry proof; place composition and turn forensics deeper in the stack.

dos: Do use ink/paper inversion for active controls and decisive status bands.
Do use stipple, stripes, labels, and borders together so state survives without color.
Do keep the three-card stack addressable and restore focus after navigation.
Do disable the stepped card transition under reduced-motion preferences.
donts: Don't introduce semantic colors, gradients, glass effects, rounded cards, or gauge-like chrome.
Don't flatten the cards into generic KPI tiles or hide the stack behind a single-panel shell.
Don't apply the Last/Session scope control to Turn History; it is always the session record.
Don't promote isolated measurements or copy treatments into shared tokens.
